mapper.select: select app_id, repository_id, directory_path, alias, merge_enabled, sdd_folder_name, description, version, updated_at from application_asset_references where app_id = #{appId} order by repository_id, directory_path
mapper.insert: insert into application_asset_references(app_id, repository_id, directory_path, alias, merge_enabled, sdd_folder_name, description, version, updated_at) values (#{row.appId}, #{row.repositoryId}, #{row.directoryPath}, #{row.alias}, #{row.mergeEnabled}, #{row.sddFolderName}, #{row.description}, #{row.version}, #{row.updatedAt}) on conflict do nothing
mapper.select: with claimable as ( select workspace_id from application_asset_reference_import_sources where linux_server_id = #{linuxServerId} and (status = 'PENDING' or (status = 'SCANNING' and lease_until < #{now})) and (next_retry_at is null or next_retry_at <= #{now}) order by workspace_id limit #{limit} for update skip locked ) update application_asset_reference_import_sources s set status = 'SCANNING', lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, next_retry_at = null from claimable c where s.workspace_id = c.workspace_id returning s.workspace_id, s.app_id, s.linux_server_id
mapper.insert: insert into application_asset_reference_import_candidates(workspace_id, app_id, repository_id, directory_path, alias, merge_enabled, sdd_folder_name, description) values (#{row.workspaceId}, #{row.appId}, #{row.repositoryId}, #{row.directoryPath}, #{row.alias}, #{row.mergeEnabled}, #{row.sddFolderName}, #{row.description})
mapper.select: select s.app_id from application_asset_reference_import_sources s left join application_asset_reference_import_results r on r.app_id = s.app_id where r.app_id is null group by s.app_id having count(*) filter (where s.status != 'DONE') = 0 order by s.app_id limit 100
mapper.insert: insert into application_asset_reference_import_results(app_id, completed_at) values (#{appId}, #{now}) on conflict do nothing
mapper.select: select workspace_id, app_id, repository_id, directory_path, alias, merge_enabled, sdd_folder_name, description from application_asset_reference_import_candidates where app_id = #{appId} order by alias, workspace_id
mapper.insert: insert into application_asset_reference_import_conflicts(app_id, alias, reason, detected_at) values (#{appId}, #{alias}, #{reason}, #{now}) on conflict (app_id, alias) do update set reason = excluded.reason, detected_at = excluded.detected_at
mapper.delete: delete from application_asset_reference_import_conflicts where app_id = #{appId} and alias = #{alias}
mapper.select: select alias, reason from application_asset_reference_import_conflicts where app_id = #{appId} order by alias
select count(*) from application_asset_reference_import_sources s left join application_asset_reference_import_results r on r.app_id = s.app_id where s.app_id = #{appId} and r.app_id is null
